sources.title: Government of Jersey, Bank and public holiday dates
sources.said: 2026: New Year's Day 1 January Thursday; Good Friday 3 April Friday; Easter Monday 6 April Monday; Early May bank holiday 4 May Monday; Liberation Day 9 May Saturday (no substitute day, this means Friday 8 May and Monday 11 May are normal working days); Spring Bank Holiday 25 May Monday; Summer Bank Holiday 31 August Monday; Christmas Day 25 December Friday; Boxing Day (substitute day) 28 December Monday. 2027: New Year's Day 1 January Friday; Good Friday 26 March Friday; Easter Monday 29 March Monday; Early May bank holiday 3 May Monday; Liberation Day 9 May Sunday; Spring Bank Holiday 31 May Monday; Summer Bank Holiday 30 August Monday; Christmas Day (substitute day) 27 December Monday; Boxing Day (substitute day) 28 December Tuesday.
